title: Task Brief — Common Envelope
description: Standard dispatch contract from Queen to a specialist agent. Every brief must satisfy this schema regardless of role.

contract_version.description: Semantic version of this contract schema, e.g. '1.0'.

task_id.description: Unique identifier for this task. Records may reference this id across artifacts and returns.

request_source.description: Origin of the request that produced this task.

objective.description: One-paragraph statement of what this task should accomplish.

why_this_agent.description: Explicit justification for routing to this specialist rather than another. Prevents arbitrary delegation.

inputs.description: Every input the specialist needs to complete the task. Paths, database references, or prior artifact IDs.

location.description: Workspace-relative path, table name, URL, or artifact task_id.

description.description: What this input contains and how the specialist should use it.

required_work.description: Ordered list of work steps the specialist must perform.

out_of_scope.description: Explicit boundaries the specialist must not cross.

success_criteria.description: Every criterion that must be satisfied for a 'succeeded' status. If any is unmet, the agent must return a non-succeeded status.

required_output.description: Structure and location of the expected deliverable.

location.description: Workspace-relative path where the output should be written.

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference or inline schema for structured outputs.

dependencies.description: Task IDs or artifact paths that must be complete before this task begins.

risks.description: Known risks or failure modes the specialist should watch for.

deadline.description: ISO-8601 timestamp by which this task should complete, if applicable.
